hero.tagline: Ancient Wisdom · Holistic Living · Inner Awakening

mission.lead: A living sanctuary where seekers from every corner of the world come to experience the depths of Vedic wisdom, Himalayan yoga, and sacred service.
mission.support: A Not-for-profit and volunteer-run organization, rooted in the ancient Ramanandi lineage and guided by the direct grace of Enlightened Guru, His Holiness Jagadguru Mahayogi Siddhababa.

mahayog.title: Mahayog
mahayog.desc: The ancient meditation of automatic Kundalini awakening

mahayogi.title: Mahayogi
mahayogi.desc: His Holiness Jagadguru Mahayogi Siddhababa — living master and guide

forMankind.title: For Mankind
forMankind.desc: Sacred service, selfless giving and the upliftment of all beings

meditation.label: Himalayan Siddha Mahayog
meditation.desc: Receive Shaktipat initiation and experience the automatic awakening of Kundalini — effortlessly integrating all four yoga paths as taught by Siddhababa.

ashram.label: Ashram and Yogic Life
ashram.desc: Immerse yourself in the daily rhythm of Barahachhetra — morning puja, gau seva, satsang, prasad, and the stillness of a consecrated Himalayan sanctuary.

vedanta.label: Vedanta Philosophy
vedanta.desc: A 300-hour live course taught personally by Siddhababa — exploring Brahman, the Self, and the nature of Reality, practised alongside daily Mahayog meditation.

service.label: Selfless Service
service.desc: From building Vedic learning centers and caring for sacred cows to serving daily free meals and nurturing youth — selfless service as the highest spiritual practice.

guru.heading: Jagadguru Mahayogi Siddhababa
guru.para1: Born in the Himalayan foothills of Nepal, His Holiness has an unwavering commitment to the inner awakening of all beings and collective human welfare. He is a rare spiritual master with the ability to awaken Kundalini and transmit experiential knowledge of the chakra system and advanced states of consciousness.
guru.para2: His life reflects profound depth of yogic attainment, including publicly demonstrated Bhu Samadhis — underground burials in meditation. Through his teachings, once-guarded Himalayan practices have been made accessible to the modern world, while preserving their authenticity and purpose.

gurukul.title: Jagadguru Ramanandacharya Gurukul
gurukul.desc: A residential Gurukul at Chataradham, Barahakshetra — blending Vedic values, Sanskrit, and meditation with a full modern curriculum for Grades 6–12, in a sattvic and disciplined environment.

ramMandir.title: Ram Mandir — Dev Sabha
ramMandir.desc: A nine-storey Sri Yantra temple rising at Chatara Dham, Sunsari — envisioned as a sacred replica of Dev Sabha, the divine assembly of the 33 koti devatas, with Lord Ram and Maa Sita at the centre.

hanuman.title: 108 Hanuman Temples Across Nepal
hanuman.desc: A sacred vow to establish 108 Hanuman temples nationwide — each a vibrant community centre rooted in Sanatan Dharma, offering meditation, education, and cultural revival built alongside local communities.

cultural.title: Cultural & Ecological Advocacy
cultural.desc: A Green Revolution for Nepal's agricultural self-reliance and the establishment of Nepal's first Ayurveda University — honouring the land, restoring ancient sciences, and empowering communities.

barahachhetra.title: The Spiritual Significance of Barahachhetra
barahachhetra.excerpt: Where the Koshi meets the sacred confluence — a living tirtha that has drawn seekers, kings, and siddhas for millennia.

kundalini.title: Kundalini, the Chakras, and the Inner Science of Awakening
kundalini.excerpt: An exploration of the subtle body, the dormant energy within, and the authentic Vedic understanding of spiritual unfoldment.

mahayogVideo.title: What Is Himalayan Siddha Mahayog?
mahayogVideo.excerpt: Siddhababa gives a direct and clear description of this unique meditation practice — what it is, how it works, and why it differs from other paths.

guruSoul.title: The Guru and the Imperishable Soul
guruSoul.excerpt: Understanding the conscious principle within — and why the relationship with a living Guru is central to the path of realisation.

donate.body: The Academy runs entirely through the generosity of devotees and well-wishers worldwide. Your gift — however modest — allows us to continue serving.

closing.quote: "True change begins not in the world outside — it begins in the silence and sincerity of the seeker within."

foundation.heading: Ancient Wisdom for the Modern World
foundation.imgAlt: Ancient Sanskrit manuscripts and sacred texts by lamplight
foundation.p1: Mahayogi Siddhababa Spiritual Academy is a not-for-profit, volunteer-run organization based in Nepal, dedicated to preserving and sharing an authentic tradition of yoga and meditation.
foundation.p2: The Academy focuses on sharing Vedic knowledge and offering direct practice of meditation and self-inquiry, alongside core principles of selfless service, ethical living, and personal responsibility. Its approach is practical and lived, integrating inner development with everyday life.
foundation.p3: Through its programs, teachings, and community initiatives, the Academy supports individuals in developing clarity of mind, stability of being, and a deeper understanding of themselves, while contributing meaningfully to the world around them.

pillars.heading: Six Pillars of Service
pillars.intro: The Academy's work is rooted in six interconnected pillars of service, which guide its programs, projects, and practices.

swastha.label: Holistic Health
swastha.desc: Cultivating vitality across all dimensions of existence.

sikshya.title: Sikshya
sikshya.label: Authentic Education
sikshya.desc: Awakening inner intelligence through sacred Vedic learning.

sanskar.title: Sanskar
sanskar.label: Character & Values
sanskar.desc: Refining the self through positive impressions and ritual.

sadvritta.title: Sadvritta
sadvritta.label: Ethical Conduct

samriddhi.title: Samriddhi
samriddhi.label: Collective Prosperity
samriddhi.desc: Fostering abundance that uplifts the welfare of all.

shanti.title: Shanti
shanti.label: Peace
shanti.desc: Realising the profound stillness at the core of all being.

meditation.title: Mahayog Meditation
meditation.desc: Explore Mahayog, a complete, time-tested system for inner transformation rooted in the Vedic tradition.

vedanta.title: Vedanta Philosophy Course
vedanta.desc: Explore the timeless teachings of Vedanta — the philosophy of non-duality, self-inquiry, and the nature of ultimate reality.

ashram.title: The Ashram
ashram.desc: Step into a place of stillness and renewal, our Ashram offers a sanctuary for deep practice and retreat.

guru.title: Enlightened Guru Siddhababa
guru.desc: Learn about the life and divine mission of His Holiness Jagadguru Mahayogi Siddhababa, the heart of the Academy.

intro.p1: Himalayan Siddha Mahayog arises from a living lineage of Himalayan Siddha Yogis who refined a precise science of meditation and inner awakening through direct experience.
intro.p2: For thousands of years, this knowledge has been transmitted from realized teacher to prepared student, preserving wisdom with clarity, responsibility, and depth of practice. This lineage is currently entrusted to His Holiness Jagadguru Ramanandacharya Swami Ramakrishnacharya Ji Maharaj (Mahayogi Siddhababa), as the present Āchārya.

hero.title: Ashram & Centers
hero.subtitle: A Spiritual Home for All

ashram.whatIs: — a Sanskrit word for a place of refuge, effort, and inner work. An Ashram is a living community centred around spiritual practice, selfless service, and the guidance of a Guru, open to all sincere seekers.

guruAshram.heading: On the Banks of the Sacred Koshi River
guruAshram.p1: Situated on the banks of the sacred Kaushiki (Koshi) River, the Guru Ashram spans over 10 acres in Chataradham, Barahachetra, Nepal. Surrounded by hills, rivers, and natural beauty, the ashram offers the ideal environment for peace, reflection, and deep meditation.
guruAshram.p2: Open to visitors and spiritual seekers from all walks of life, the Guru Ashram serves as a spiritual home, supporting sincere practice and quiet contemplation.
guruAshram.imgAlt: The sacred Kaushiki (Koshi) River flowing through the misty hills of Nepal

transformation.heading: A Place of Transformation
transformation.p1: The Ashram follows traditional Vedic principles while providing modern amenities for visiting seekers. Daily meditation sessions, satsangs, and seva opportunities create a complete spiritual immersion experience.
transformation.p2: Whether you are visiting for a day or staying for an extended retreat, the Ashram offers the space and support for sincere spiritual practice.
transformation.imgAlt: Seekers meditating in the ashram grounds before the Hanuman statue

pillars.heading: Three Pillars of Practice
pillars.intro: The Guru Ashram is a rare place where seekers can engage in all three together in a supportive and loving setting.

sumiran.title: Meditation & Remembrance
sumiran.desc: The practice of inner stillness, turning the mind toward the divine through daily meditation, mantra, and conscious remembrance of the eternal self.

seva.title: Selfless Service
seva.desc: Sacred action performed without attachment to reward. Seva purifies the heart, dissolves ego, and transforms everyday work into a form of worship.

satsang.title: Spiritual Discourse
satsang.desc: Gathering in the company of truth, receiving wisdom from the Guru and senior practitioners, asking questions, and deepening understanding through sacred dialogue.

life.heading: Ashram Life
life.intro: Experience the rhythm of spiritual community living.

items.title: Sacred Living Spaces
items.desc: Simple, serene accommodations designed to support spiritual practice, inner contemplation, and a life free from unnecessary distraction.

items.title: Daily Satsang
items.desc: Regular spiritual discourses and Q&A sessions with Gurudev and senior practitioners, guidance for every stage of the path.

items.title: Seva Opportunities
items.desc: Contribute meaningfully to ashram life through selfless service, a powerful spiritual practice in its own right. All forms of seva are equally valued.

items.title: Sattvic Meals
items.desc: Nourishing vegetarian meals prepared with love, following Ayurvedic principles, food as medicine, offered as prasad.

akhanda.heading: Akhanda Kīrtan
akhanda.p1: The Hanuman Temple at the Ashram holds an unbroken stream of devotional chanting. The Ram mantra has been recited continuously, 24 hours a day, without interruption since 2010.
akhanda.p2: means "unbroken" — this living practice embodies the ideal of constant remembrance, filling the ashram with an ever-present current of sacred sound that supports all who enter.

sevaSection.title: Seva
sevaSection.p1: Seva plays a central role in spiritual growth, cultivating humility and reducing ego through selfless action. Seekers can offer seva according to their interests, skills, and professional experience.
sevaSection.p2: All forms of seva are valued equally, no service is considered superior or inferior.

satsangSection.title: Satsang
satsangSection.p1: During Satsang, seekers gather to receive guidance and wisdom from Gurudev. This sacred space allows individuals to ask questions, reflect, and deepen understanding.
satsangSection.p2: Sitting in the presence of enlightened Jagadguru Mahayogi Siddhababa offers itself clarity and inner insight, an essential support for every sincere seeker.

sevaCta.heading: Participate in Ashram Seva
sevaCta.intro: The ashram is sustained entirely through the generosity and devotion of seekers. By contributing, you become part of this sacred mission — supporting spiritual education, daily prasad, gau seva, and the care of this living spiritual home.

visit.heading: Plan a Visit
visit.intro: The Guru Ashram welcomes sincere seekers from all backgrounds. Whether for a day visit, a weekend, or an extended stay, come and experience a place where ancient wisdom is lived.

items.title: The Spiritual Significance of Barahachhetra
items.excerpt: In the sacred geography of Sanātan Dharma, certain lands do not merely witness divinity. They hold it. Barahachhetra is one such land — revered across ages by gods, rishis, avatars, ancestors, and saints.

items.title: Nepal: Spirituality's Beating Heart
items.excerpt: Nepal is described in sacred traditions as a land where the divine is not distant but actively present. Siddhababa reveals Nepal as Bhū-Vaikuṇṭha — an earthly expression of the divine realm.

items.title: Reviving Nepal's Ancient Wisdom: Yoga, Āyurveda & Nāḍī Science
items.excerpt: A rich Malaku TV conversation on Nepal's ancient knowledge systems — the science of yoga, the healing arts of Āyurveda, and the profound diagnostic tradition of Nāḍī Science.

nepalOthers.note: Naya Bazar, Balaju (next to Bishumati Bridge)

hanuman.title: 108 Hanuman Temples
hanuman.intro: Jagadguru Mahayogi Siddhababa has undertaken a sacred vow to establish 108 Hanuman Temples across Nepal, a visionary initiative dedicated to spiritual renewal, cultural preservation, and social upliftment. These temples are envisioned not only as places of worship, but as vibrant community centers rooted in Sanatan Dharma, built with and managed by local communities.
hanuman.portraitAlt: Lord Hanuman statue at a Nepali temple

features.title: Multi-Purpose Hall
features.desc: A 200–250 person hall adaptable for satsang, group meditation, cultural celebrations, youth programs, and community gatherings.

features.title: Mahayog Meditation Center
features.desc: Each temple doubles as a teaching center offering meditation, Vedic science, Sanatan Dharma philosophy, and sadhana programs.

features.title: Community Infrastructure
features.desc: Dedicated rooms for worship, seva kitchen (Anna Seva), pujari preparation, storage, and an administrative office.

hanuman.programsLabel: Programs Offered at Each Hanuman Temple
programs: Teachings on Sanatan Dharma and Hindu philosophy
Cultural education in sanskar and sanskriti

banner.heading: A Sacred Legacy in the Making
banner.intro: Your gift becomes a lasting legacy, each temple a living center of prayer, learning, and community, rooted in dharma for generations to come.

types.title: Land Contribution
types.desc: Donate private land, facilitate government allocation, or help identify and restore historic temple sites across Nepal.

types.title: Financial Support
types.desc: Monetary or in-kind donations toward construction, educational programming, sadhana activities, and ongoing temple maintenance.

quote.text: The body is temporary; it will pass. Let us leave behind something of lasting value that teaches sanskar and sanskriti to future generations.

ramMandir.title: Ram Mandir
ramMandir.featureImgAlt: Ram Mandir architectural rendering with Hanuman statue
ramMandir.p1: A historic Ram Mandir will be built at Jagadguru Ramanadacharya Seva Peeth (Tarak Brahma Peeth), Chatara Dham, envisioned as a sacred replica of Dev Sabha, the divine assembly of the 33 koti devatas, with Lord Ram, Maa Sita and their divine family at the center.
ramMandir.p2: This temple will not only be a place of worship, but a living spiritual and cosmological experience, its architecture based on the structure of the universe as described in Vedic scripture and realized through the spiritual insight of Jagadguru Mahayogi Siddhababa.

journey.name: Primordial Nothingness
journey.desc: The state before creation, pure unmanifest consciousness.

journey.name: Tri-Guna
journey.desc: The emergence of Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas, the three fundamental qualities of nature.

journey.name: Prakriti
journey.desc: The manifestation of primordial nature, the source of the material universe.

journey.name: Mahat
journey.desc: The arising of cosmic intelligence, the first great principle of creation.

journey.name: Ahankar
journey.desc: The formation of individual identity and ego as creation becomes individuated.

journey.name: The Present Age
journey.desc: The full unfolding of creation and the journey through the four Yugas into Kali Yuga.

ramMandir.yugasLabel: The Four Yugas, Cycle of Time

arch.title: Nine-Storey Structure
arch.desc: A majestic nine-storey temple symbolizing ascent through layers of consciousness and existence.

arch.title: Sri Yantra Architecture
arch.desc: The entire design is based on sacred geometry of the Sri Yantra, the union of cosmic energies and structure of creation.

arch.title: 33 Koti Devatas
arch.desc: Arranged according to universal Vastu principles from Vedic scripture, with Lord Ram and His divine family at the spiritual center.

arch.title: Nepal's Cultural Heritage
arch.desc: A living model integrating elements from Nepal's diverse communities, with curated representations of the nation's spiritual and historical evolution.

banner.heading: Help Bring This Vision to Life
banner.intro: This temple is a gift to Nepal and to the world. Whether through expertise, cultural knowledge, or financial support, your contribution shapes something that will endure for centuries.
